FREE TOOL · TAX & CLOSING

Small business tax & closing tool

Upload bank transactions and invoice exports and the tool matches documents, writes the journal, estimates sales tax, runs payroll with FICA and withholding, settles foreign-currency gains and builds a year-end closing summary. Everything is calculated and stored in your browser only, and exports go out as CSV or an A4 printout.

No data leaves your browserSaved in localStorage6 modules: sales tax, payroll, FX, closingCSV upload and manual entry
Saved in this browser automatically

What this tool does — and does not do
  • It does not connect to the IRS, your bank or your accounting software. You upload a CSV exported from your bank or invoicing tool, or type entries in.
  • The summaries and CSVs are working papers for your return or your accountant. Nothing is filed from here.
  • Everything is kept in your browser's localStorage. Clearing site data deletes it, so download a backup.
  • Rates are published federal figures with simple rules. State taxes, credits and book-tax adjustments are not modelled.

03Payroll, FICA and withholding

PAYROLL & WITHHOLDING

Add employees and the tool computes Social Security, Medicare, federal withholding, net pay and employer cost, then lays out the payroll ledger and withholding summary.

Employer settings

RATES

Social Security 6.2% up to the annual wage base, Medicare 1.45% (employer matches both), FUTA 0.6% and state unemployment on the first $7,000 of wages. Federal withholding is estimated from annualised taxable wages and filing status. State income tax is not withheld — set it in your payroll system.

Employees and owners 0

04Foreign currency settlement

FX SETTLEMENT

The rate on the ship date and the rate on the day the money arrived differ — that difference is the FX gain or loss. Year-end balances are revalued at the closing rate.

This is a reference tool built on published federal rates and the data you enter — not tax or accounting advice. Actual tax depends on book-tax adjustments, credits, carryforwards and state rules.
